sections.Profile:
"Running Horse" is a horse racing-themed electro-mechanical pinball machine released by the Spanish manufacturer Inder in 1976. The game accommodates a single player and features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, four kick-out holes, and seven standup targets.

- Manufacturer: Inder
- Years made: 1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Sports, Horses, Original Theme, Horse Racing, 1970s
